$comment: Copy this into a project (e.g. qa/scenarios.json) and edit the fixture/scenario list to match that project's own QA sheet. This template's entries are derived from a Spectrum LP release QA sheet — dot-namespaced scenario ids double as the `scenario` field written into result JSONL rows.

address_fixtures.address: 145 New Bern St. Apt 348, Charlotte, NC 28209

scenarios.assertion: Exactly one SessionStarted request in the boot HAR (capture started before navigation). Does not re-fire on reload with the same sessionID/anonID.
PageViewed fires before any elementViewed in the same HAR window; payload matches the eventing standards doc.
Exactly one DomCompleted request per page load.
View events fire for every tracked asset entering viewport. Only flag as duplicate when htmlId + elementType + location repeat for the same owner.
Click events fire for every CTA, payload matches standards doc, and a manual click never also emits an auto-click for the same interaction.
Fires once per 25/50/75/100 threshold per page view. Repeated identical scrollDistance values are the defect signal.
Fires twice: once early, once after DomCompleted with both Tealium and Adobe IDs present. Does not fire for ID stitching when GPC is enabled.

See references/monarch.md — returnable.experience.experienceName equals the expected default experience (e.g. 'Default Internet Hero Experience'). Cross-check against rendered UI; Monarch fails silently to local defaults.
Fires once after ~15-30s of dwell/interaction (scroll or click), not immediately.
Fires on localization submission; inspect across the handoff/navigation boundary, not just pre-navigation state.
Fires with full payload. GPC enabled -> only 001/002 cookies fire. GPC disabled -> 001-005 fire and coreIdentify exchanges IDs.
V-param, TFN, cmp, and related params persist to non-RV-owned pages before localization.
AFFPN, address info, V-param persist through and after localization for attribution/TFN.
Serviceable address proceeds through order flow without error.
Address missing an apartment number prompts for apartment input before proceeding.
Unserviceable address redirects to the Cox partner surface.
Unserviceable address redirects to the Xfinity partner surface.
Invalid/unknown route (e.g. /fdfd) renders the error page, not a blank/crashed one.
